easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
